EC1: Patients with liver cirrhosis [OR], Hepatocellular Carcinoma [OR] or other malignancies.
EC2: Patients with other factors causing liver diseases.
EC4: Patients with concomitant HIV infection [OR] or congenital immune deficiency diseases.
EC7: Patients with serious complications (e.g., infection [OR], hepatic encephalopathy [OR], hepatorenal syndrome [OR], gastrointestinal bleeding.)
EC8: Patients who receive antineoplastic or immunomodulatory therapy in the past 12 months.
EC9: Patients who can't come back to clinic for follow-up on schedule.
